name: Technical Singlet
title: S1 — Technical Singlet
tagline: Sleeveless technical singlet with short legs. Same construction language as C.
construction: clean uninterrupted front panel (no front closure)
construction_prompt: A sleeveless technical latex singlet with a stand collar, a clean uninterrupted front panel with no zip or closure, short legs ending mid-thigh with simple cut latex edges, and a close athletic fit. Made from glued sheet latex with flat bonded joins between technical panels - not sewn seams, piping or edging. Contoured technical panel design across the chest, torso and hips with a central front column, inner thigh panels and a centre-back stripe. The stand collar is integrated latex construction, not a separate fabric band. Arms and shoulders are bare skin; the garment ends at the shoulders. No zips, fasteners, hardware or decorative construction anywhere on the garment.

core.label: Core structure
parts: central front column from collar through crotch
